svg.title: Smart Product Framework - End-to-End Sequence Flow

g.text: Smart Product Framework - End-to-End Sequence Flow
The generic factory is the source of truth for:
read chunks + verify hash + lock resource
read chunks + verify hash + lock resource
TextResource also supports one-shot publication by passing
content and its expected hash to the constructor. DemoEndToEndWorkflow uses
the staged appendChunk + finalize workflow shown above.
ProductDocumentationTemplate each contain a parse="text" XInclude.
evmstate bindings are returned as text and are not evaluated
store active quote board + touch indication version
and the stored contract address, indication ID, and part ID.
Live curve state remains a separate CurveRegistry view.
Assignment accepts Active or Suspended indications.
Current trade creation does not re-check indication liveness.
expand quote rows and format fields
it is not currently declared by IProductSpecificFactory.
Product State Rendering and Documentation Generation
and ProductResources role wrappers containing both XIncludes
evmstate bindings. During state-part rendering it also
supports one uint256 callback argument supplied as $partId.
It does not currently execute XSLT;
DemoEndToEndWorkflow applies the product documentation template separately.
